entries.body: R1: board empty; CHG-108 PROPOSED (HPA search, not applied). Logs only background slow query WARNs.

R2: board: follow-ups OPEN ALERT_TUNING, RUNBOOK_UPDATE, VENDOR_TICKET (board.md:3-5). changes: CHG-120 APPLIED notify-worker build 8.56.0 sets http.max_inflight=0 (round-02/changes.md:4) -> suspect BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT, but no notify errors yet; CHG-121 payments no config. auth-svc db pool exhausted WARNs (round-02/logs/auth-svc.log:1,3,15,22,23,25,44,65,69) -> candidate DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED auth-svc, no board thread yet. Next: advance to R3.

CHG-133 TLS ticket rotation irrelevant. Thread A continues: auth pool WARNs round-04/logs/auth-svc.log:7,9,19,26; search-api round-04/logs/search-api.log:4,11,13,14. Still no notify errors. Next: advance to R5.

R5: Thread A mitigated after CHG-143 APPLIED auth-svc mitigation (round-05/board.md:3; round-05/changes.md:4). Thread B now also checkout-api, cause CACHE_STAMPEDE per board (round-05/board.md:4) but logs still 429 fx-rates: checkout round-05/logs/checkout-api.log:21,23,30; payments round-05/logs/payments-svc.log:13. Follow-up OPEN CAPACITY_REVIEW (round-05/board.md:5). CHG-138 TLS irrelevant. Next: advance R6.

R6: board: CLOSED ALERT_TUNING; OPEN CUSTOMER_COMMS (round-06/board.md:3-4). CHG-147 retry budget irrelevant. payments 429 fx-rates round-06/logs/payments-svc.log:3,10,11. No notify errors. Next: advance R7.
R7: board no updates, no changes.md. 429 fx-rates continues: payments round-07/logs/payments-svc.log:1,7,13; checkout round-07/logs/checkout-api.log:11,19,25. auth/notify quiet. Next: advance R8.
